reader.requirement: At 1985, without REPLACING, every affected elementary item of category alphabetic, alphanumeric or alphanumeric edited receives MOVE SPACES and every numeric or numeric edited item receives MOVE ZEROS (with the receiver's editing), regardless of VALUE clauses, FILLER and index items (GR3) and subordinate REDEFINES (GR4) excepted.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the 1985 form; 2002+ adds the VALUE and DEFAULT phrases that change the sender, refused at 85
